public.title: Minimum Height Trees
public.description: The input is a connected undirected tree on vertices 0 through n-1. Return, in ascending order, the vertices that minimize the maximum distance to any other vertex when chosen as root. n is 1 to 500; edges contains n-1 distinct pairs of different vertices.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Peeling all leaves at once preserves the centers until one or two remain. Each edge is removed once, giving O(n) time and space.
